title: 分层封装与有效载荷率：MTU/MSS 与每层首部开销
expected_output:
=== encapsulation: each layer adds a header ===
   app  TCP seg  IP dgram  L2 frame   wire  efficiency
     1       21        41        59     67       1.69%
   100      120       140       158    166      63.29%
   536      556       576       594    602      90.24%
  1400     1420      1440      1458   1466      96.02%
  1460     1480      1500      1518   1526      96.18%

MTU = 1500
MSS = MTU - IP_HDR - TCP_HDR = 1460
L2 frame  = dst(6)+src(6)+type(2)+data(46..1500)+FCS(4) = 64..1518 B
on medium = L2 frame + preamble(8 B physical sync)       = 72..1526 B
efficiency is computed on the L2 FRAME (preamble is per-transmission sync)
1-byte payload -> IP datagram 41 B, L2 frame 59 B, on the medium 67 B

=== why small packets hurt ===
      1 bytes payload -> efficiency   1.69%
    100 bytes payload -> efficiency  63.29%
   1400 bytes payload -> efficiency  96.02%
Nagle merges small writes; TCP_NODELAY disables it for latency-critical paths
code:
ETH_HDR, ETH_FCS, PREAMBLE = 14, 4, 8
IP_HDR, TCP_HDR = 20, 20
MTU = 1500

def encap(app_bytes):
    tcp = app_bytes + TCP_HDR
    ip = tcp + IP_HDR
    frame = ip + ETH_HDR + ETH_FCS          # L2 frame, preamble NOT counted
    wire = frame + PREAMBLE                 # bytes actually put on the medium
    return tcp, ip, frame, wire

print("=== encapsulation: each layer adds a header ===")
print(f"{'app':>6} {'TCP seg':>8} {'IP dgram':>9} {'L2 frame':>9} {'wire':>6} {'efficiency':>11}")
for app in (1, 100, 536, 1400, 1460):
    tcp, ip, frame, wire = encap(app)
    print(f"{app:>6} {tcp:>8} {ip:>9} {frame:>9} {wire:>6} {app/frame*100:>10.2f}%")

print()
print("MTU =", MTU)
print("MSS = MTU - IP_HDR - TCP_HDR =", MTU - IP_HDR - TCP_HDR)
print("L2 frame  = dst(6)+src(6)+type(2)+data(46..1500)+FCS(4) = 64..1518 B")
print("on medium = L2 frame + preamble(8 B physical sync)       = 72..1526 B")
print("efficiency is computed on the L2 FRAME (preamble is per-transmission sync)")
_t1, _i1, _f1, _w1 = encap(1)
print(f"1-byte payload -> IP datagram {_i1} B, L2 frame {_f1} B, on the medium {_w1} B")

print()
print("=== why small packets hurt ===")
for app in (1, 100, 1400):
    eff = app / encap(app)[2] * 100
    print(f"  {app:>5} bytes payload -> efficiency {eff:>6.2f}%")
print("Nagle merges small writes; TCP_NODELAY disables it for latency-critical paths")
